title: fix(scenarios): a controlled-by-parent detail its own read policy narrows counts as kept to the persona's rows

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景评分器 `@objectstack/scenarios` 的 `row-level-security` 构建检查:对 `controlled_by_parent` 明细对象,若角色自己权限集上对该明细的读策略能单独收窄它(至少一条生效、没有一条放行全部行、每条都能降为查询过滤),就判为已限定,不再只看主表。
- 为什么改:gallery 构建 `asset_lifecycle` 里 `demoasset_checkout` 的主表 `demoasset_employee` 是 `public_read`,但员工权限集对 checkout 本身有 `employee in current_user.my_employee_ids` 读策略;引擎把明细自己的 RLS 与主表派生过滤 AND 在一起,员工只看得到自己的借用记录,评分器却判失败,挡住了 gallery 导出。
- 风险与回滚:只改评分器一个分支,并把已有的「收窄」判断抽成一个小函数复用(行为不变);不碰任何引擎或插件代码。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts` 的 `narrowsOnItsOwn`(L402)和 `rowSecurityGap` 里新增的一行(L451)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts`,预期 88 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts`:

- New module-private `narrowsOnItsOwn(policies)` (L402): at least one read policy applies and none admits every row. This is the predicate the grader already applied to a non-CBP object's own policies, lifted out of its two copies (`rowSecurityGap`'s last line, now L458, and the row-scope check, now L658) so all three sites ask one predicate. Those two sites behave exactly as before.
- `rowSecurityGap`, `controlled_by_parent` branch (L451): when the persona's own read policies on the detail narrow it, return no gap before following the master. The "each lowers to a filter" leg is the existing `dead` check at the top of the function, which already runs first for every object, CBP or not. When the detail's policies do not narrow it, the master is followed exactly as before.
- The function's doc comment now says a detail takes the read-policy route too, and why (the engine's AND, below).

`packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts`: one new `describe` in the row-level-security block (L619), on the golden fixture's `task` (a `controlled_by_parent` detail of `project`) with `project` set to `public_read`:

- (a) passes: a detail policy `project in current_user.my_project_ids` (the build's `employee in current_user.my_employee_ids` shape);
- (b) still fails, master followed: no detail policy; a detail policy `true`; and a narrowing one beside a `true` one;
- (c) still fails: a detail policy that does not lower to a filter (`size(name) > 2`), alone and beside a narrowing one.

`.changeset/33414-scenario-grader-cbp-detail-own-policy.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/scenarios`, a file name unique to this card.

## Why

The gallery debut refresh's build check `row-level-security:demoasset_checkout->enforced` failed with "no read policy on demoasset_employee narrows demoasset_employee", although the build scopes the employee's checkouts with a read policy on the detail itself. I re-read the engine to confirm the card's premise before writing the grader around it:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` L2495–2535, the find path: for every read with an `ast`, it pushes `andComposeLayers(layer0, layer1)` from `computeLayeredRlsFilter` (tenant wall plus the authored RLS policies), then `computeControlledByParentFilter` for the same object, into one `extra` list; L2615–2620 composes `extra` with the caller's `where` as one `$and`.
- `security-plugin.ts` L2985–2993 (`getReadFilter`'s contract) states the same three-layer composition, and `security-plugin-rls-filter.ts` (the commit 6feac910b note at L272) drops only the platform's wildcard WRITE ownership floor for a CBP detail, never an authored read policy.

So an authored read policy on a CBP detail is ANDed with the master-derived filter, and a detail it narrows is kept to the persona's rows whatever the master admits. No path skipping the detail's authored RLS on a CBP read was found.

## Tests

- `test/score/scenario-tags.test.ts`: 88/88 pass; the whole package suite 32 files, 703/703 (after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`, which its two `test/build/*` suites need).
- Ablation, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` on the new line `if (narrowsOnItsOwn(policies)) return undefined;` (mutation landed, blob `041868f9` → `191bdf4a`; restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): test (a) red with `Expected "enforced for pm_contractor"`, `Received "no read policy on pm_contractor narrows project"` (the build's failure, on the fixture); (b) and (c) stay green, 1 failed / 2 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- Card Ask 3, re-grade: the recorded run lives in the filing seat's work dir and is not reachable from this container, so I replayed the build check instead with the smallest fixture that reaches it: the real `asset_lifecycle` card loaded and namespaced as the runner does (`loadScenarios` → `namespacedScenario` → `scoreCardArtifact`), against a two-object artifact (`demoasset_employee` `public_read`; `demoasset_checkout` `controlled_by_parent` with `employee` master-detail) and the two permission sets the card scopes checkout for (`demoasset_employee` with `employee_own_checkouts` on the detail; `demoasset_dept_manager` with a roster policy on the master, since the card scopes the roster itself for the manager). Result:
  - on `origin/main` `4ace1fa9`: `{"check":"row-level-security:demoasset_checkout->enforced","pass":false,"detail":"no read policy on demoasset_employee narrows demoasset_employee"}`, the recorded failure word for word;
  - on this branch: `{"check":"row-level-security:demoasset_checkout->enforced","pass":true,"detail":"enforced for demoasset_employee, demoasset_dept_manager"}`.
  The replay script is a scratch file, not committed; the new tests carry the same shape.
- Card Ask 4: no security finding (see Why).
- The row-scope check (`access-security.row-scope`) already passed every CBP detail and is unchanged.
